subject: numeracy
nipun_lo: Grade 1 goal: reads and writes numbers up to 99 and does simple addition and subtraction; this episode covers adding two small groups with a total up to 9
notes: Addition means putting two groups together and counting all of them. Start with real objects: 2 pebbles and 3 pebbles together make 5 pebbles. Count on from the bigger group instead of counting everything again (5, then 6, 7). Say it as a sentence: 4 and 2 make 6. Introduce the + and = signs on the slate only after the idea is clear. Every total stays at 9 or below. Changing the order gives the same total: 3 and 4 make 7, 4 and 3 make 7.
